title: Strata v0.1.42 Hetero capability inventory

findings.summary: VRAM cache, budgeted resident-RAM complement, and file/mmap expert source already form the product placement tiers. RAM/commit-aware clamping and file fallback exist.
Static routing profiles rank experts for placement; adaptive heat can be saved and reused. They are rankings, not backend cost/quality profiles.
Pinned arena expert loading and resident-complement copy use worker threads. FileExpertSource has separate prefetch/direct-I/O paths; these move bytes, not compute assignments.
Peer expert cache, remote CUDA expert caches and layer splits already support multi-GPU placement and compute.
findings.boundary: These mechanisms do not consume the HeteroCostModel profile.

findings.summary: Affinity modes are all, auto, and P-cores. Windows reads ProcessorRelationship efficiency classes and group masks; Linux uses topology/sysfs. API distinguishes P/E only; no LP role or E-only mode found.

Built-in calibration searches PCIe share, MTP floor, worker count, and adaptive-tier knobs. Setup persists selected engine settings by hardware/model key. It does not create per-backend quality-gated costs.
findings.caveat: The built-in path measures decode rate and restarts for some knobs; it does not establish task correctness for each alternate backend.

findings.summary: Optional asynchronous staging of the next streamed KV prefix exists inside the CUDA prefill pipeline; it is not an external KV tier.
The serve engine parks/restores conversation snapshots in RAM, honors token and free-RAM thresholds, and samples cgroup limits. This overlaps RAM/session reuse, not expert backend dispatch.

Identity-bound exact-shape costs; phases prefill/decode/vision; 3+ formal full-job timings; quality boolean, expiry, readiness/busy clocks and shared-memory contention are inputs. Acceptance requires 3+ model formals and known quality/performance gates.

findings.summary: Bounded JSON profile stores the identity, expiry, exact observations and acceptance objects; load requires hash-matching evidence files. Model acceptance evidence cannot be replaced by kernel/IPC evidence.

refs.revision: Hetero v42 and current main tools

findings.summary: A synchronous one-job-at-a-time wrapper takes immutable bytes, calls a ready helper, verifies output, quarantines failures, runs exact helper cleanup, then falls back to primary with unchanged input. KV/session mutation is excluded.

refs.revision: Hetero v42 and current main tools

findings.summary: The OpenVINO Q4_K/Q5_1 activation graph declares itself uncompiled, uninferred and production-route-disabled. It is candidate code, not a production model backend.

Hetero private-stdio KV parking modules are experiment adapters; upstream conversation cache already owns product snapshot park/restore. Keep the distinction explicit before adding another KV surface.
findings.upstream_v0_1_42: experiment modules absent; product conversation cache present

integration_hooks.location: tools/calibrate.py::measure / new separate Hetero calibration command
integration_hooks.rationale: Keep existing hardware-setting calibrator semantics; emit identity, exact shapes, complete-boundary timing, quality acceptance, expiry and evidence hashes in Hetero profile schema.

integration_hooks.location: src/program/generate.cpp Params/argument parser near --expert-profile plus serve/server.py::engine_args/config forwarding
integration_hooks.rationale: Introduce a separate opt-in Hetero profile path; do not overload the existing ranked expert placement file.

integration_hooks.location: tools/hetero_runtime.py::HeteroRuntimeScheduler.dispatch for a future explicitly owned stateless operator adapter
integration_hooks.rationale: Existing wrapper has primary fallback, output verification and helper cleanup, but no production call site. Do not route stateful verifier/KV mutation through it.

missing_capabilities: No production import/call site for HeteroCostModel or HeteroRuntimeScheduler.
No unified runtime scheduler for CPU, ARC/NPU, storage and GPU tiers or shared resource reservations.
No LP-core role; upstream affinity API exposes All, Auto and PCores with P/E handling.
Current built-in expert profiles rank residency/frequency; they do not bind per-backend latency and model-quality acceptance.
